title: Design Tokens
summary: Tokens are named design decisions that let themes and components share consistent values across platforms.

MUST.text: Use semantic tokens for roles such as text-primary, surface-default and action-primary.
Separate primitive palette/scale (color.blue.500) from semantic aliases (color.text.primary).
Store tokens in a platform-neutral format and generate platform outputs from one source.

SHOULD.text: Include type, value, description and deprecation metadata for each token.

AVOID.text: Do not hardcode repeated values across components.
Do not use primitive token names directly in component code.

DECIDE.decision: Alias per theme, keep primitive stable
Add alias, deprecate old for one cycle
Generate from same source, not hand-maintain

EXAMPLE.good: "Button uses color.action.primary which resolves to blue.600 in light and blue.400 in dark."

FAILURE_MODES: Hardcoded values drift between themes and platforms.
Primitive names in components block theming.
Token sprawl without metadata makes deprecation unsafe.

checks.text: Semantic roles real and named by role?
Platform outputs generated from one source?
